page.content:
2012 prequel about Engineers, David, and the company.

How Prometheus connects

  • Creator: Ridley Scott — Scott directed Prometheus.
  • Topic: Alien — Prometheus is a 2012 prequel in the Alien line.
  • Character: David — David is the android center of Prometheus.
  • Work: Alien: Covenant — Covenant follows Prometheus toward the xenomorph.
  • Faction: Engineers — Prometheus is the film that puts the Engineers on screen.
  • Work: Alien (1979) — Prometheus is set before the 1979 film.

What is Prometheus?

Prometheus follows a Weyland expedition toward the Engineers and the bioweapon path that later feeds Alien: Covenant.

Key threads lead to Ridley Scott, Alien, David, Alien: Covenant, Engineers and Alien (1979).
